items.description:

items.description:

items.description:

items.description:

items.title: BHC hands ex-MPA Abdul Majeed Achakzai 10-year sentence in traffic cop hit-and-run case
items.description:
QUETTA: The Balochistan High Court on Tuesday handed former MPA Abdul Majeed Achakzai a ten-year sentence in a case regarding the death of a traffic policeman in a hit-and-run incident.
